mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in quarterly GDPC1 (demand) predicts stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained GDPC1 growth, or GDPC1 growth reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS decline, or FEDFUNDS rate recovers before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in FEDFUNDS and rises in GDPC1 indicate dual easing and stronger demand, amplifying positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite the combined signal, or the proxies move in opposite directions.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in UNRATE below 4.5% signals a tight labor market, boosting corporate profits and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE drop below 4.5%, or UNRATE recovers before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Rising INDPRO (supply) and PAYEMS (labor) simultaneously indicate robust business activity and labor demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite both proxies rising, or one proxy lags the other.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in FEDFUNDS below 1.5% intensifies monetary easing, amplifying positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS below 1.5% in late-cycle, or regime shifts to contraction.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in UNRATE below 5% signals a tight labor market, driving up stock valuations and positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE drop below 5%, or UNRATE recovers before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Declining FEDFUNDS coupled with rising INDPRO indicates easing monetary policy and strong industrial production, reinforcing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite the combined signal, or the proxies move in opposite directions.
